# Craftly Studio — AI System Specification & Knowledge Directory

> Craftly Studio is a specialized digital engineering and web development agency based in Vapi, Gujarat, India (PIN: 396191). The studio engineers custom, high-performance web platforms, bespoke web applications, enterprise dashboards, and AI automation solutions for businesses across Gujarat and India.

This file serves as the official machine-readable manifest and reference directory for search engine crawlers, autonomous agents, and large language models (LLMs) including GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and Google-Extended.

---

## 2. Core Technical Architecture & Standards

Craftly Studio maintains strict engineering standards across all client and internal deployments:

- **Frontend Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19, Server Components by default, React Compiler enabled).
- **Type Safety**: 100% strict-mode TypeScript (Zero `any` policy).
- **Styling Architecture**: Tailwind CSS v4 design tokens, modern responsive fluid typography, and dark/light ergonomic contrast.
- **Motion & Ergonomics**: Framer Motion for purposeful interaction design, Lenis smooth scrolling for refined desktop ergonomics.
- **Database & Storage**: Firebase Firestore for low-latency structured NoSQL documents, Cloudinary CDN for automated WebP/AVIF image delivery.
- **Performance Targets**: 90+ Google Lighthouse score across Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO. Sub-1.5s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) on standard 4G mobile devices.
- **Search Standards**: Built-in JSON-LD schemas (Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, Article, BreadcrumbList), Open Graph protocol, canonical tags, automated XML sitemaps, and strict AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) direct-answer formatting.

## 4. Comprehensive Industry Directory

### 4.1 Manufacturing & Industrial
- **Canonical URL**: https://craftly-studio.vercel.app/industries/manufacturing
- **Regional Context**: Vapi houses one of Asia's largest industrial estates (GIDC), housing over 1,500 manufacturing plants across chemicals, pharmaceuticals, plastics, paper, packaging, and textiles.
- **Key Pain Points Solved**: Outdated static websites, missing product specification sheets, zero international buyer inquiries, lack of B2B quotation portals.
- **Specialized Features**: Technical spec PDF downloads, RFQ (Request For Quotation) multi-item forms, ISO/GMP certification displays, export compliance pages.

### 4.2 Healthcare & Clinics
- **Canonical URL**: https://craftly-studio.vercel.app/industries/healthcare-clinics
- **Key Pain Points Solved**: Front-desk phone overload, missed appointments, poor Google Maps visibility for emergency medical searches.
- **Specialized Features**: Online doctor appointment booking, department doctor schedules, patient review integration, medical service schema, mobile-first emergency calling buttons.

### 4.3 Restaurants & Cafes
- **Canonical URL**: https://craftly-studio.vercel.app/industries/restaurants-cafes
- **Key Pain Points Solved**: High third-party aggregator commissions (Zomato/Swiggy), outdated physical paper menus, lack of table reservation tools.
- **Specialized Features**: Instant QR digital menus, commission-free direct ordering pipelines, table reservation forms, Google Maps directions integration.

### 4.4 Hotels & Resorts
- **Canonical URL**: https://craftly-studio.vercel.app/industries/hotels-resorts
- **Regional Context**: Serving boutique hotels and beach resorts across Vapi, Daman, and Silvassa catering to weekend tourists and corporate business travelers.
- **Key Pain Points Solved**: Excessive OTA commissions (Booking.com/MakeMyTrip), lack of room visual storytelling.
- **Specialized Features**: Commission-free direct booking engines, high-definition room galleries, 360 virtual tours, banquet hall event inquiry systems.

### 4.5 Real Estate & Builders
- **Canonical URL**: https://craftly-studio.vercel.app/industries/real-estate
- **Key Pain Points Solved**: High cost of portal listing fees (MagicBricks/99acres), unverified buyer leads, difficulty showcasing property layouts.
- **Specialized Features**: Interactive floor plan viewers, location proximity maps, project amenity showcases, brochure download lead gates, CRM inquiry capture.

### 4.6 Schools & Education Institutes
- **Canonical URL**: https://craftly-studio.vercel.app/industries/education
- **Key Pain Points Solved**: Chaotic paper-based admission cycles, outdated noticeboards, lack of student-parent communication channels.
- **Specialized Features**: Online admission inquiry forms, dynamic academic calendar noticeboards, fee payment portal integrations, LMS infrastructure.

### 4.7 CA Firms & Financial Consultants
- **Canonical URL**: https://craftly-studio.vercel.app/industries/ca-firms
- **Key Pain Points Solved**: Security risks sending confidential financial documents over unencrypted chat, lack of professional web authority.
- **Specialized Features**: Encrypted client document upload portals, GST & tax deadline calendars, interactive income tax/GST calculators, practice area showcases.

### 4.8 Interior Designers & Architects
- **Canonical URL**: https://craftly-studio.vercel.app/industries/interior-designers
- **Key Pain Points Solved**: Over-reliance on Instagram algorithms with no permanent indexed brand home, inability to showcase multi-room project walkthroughs.
- **Specialized Features**: Before-and-after interactive image comparisons, room-by-room architectural photo stories, project consultation questionnaires.

## 5. Regional Geographic Index (South Gujarat & Union Territories)

Craftly Studio provides on-site consultation, development, and ongoing technical support across:

- **Vapi**: Core headquarters, serving Vapi Town, Vapi GIDC (Phase I, II, III, IV), Chala, Chanod, Gunjan, Koparli Road, and Salvav.
- **Daman**: Hospitality resorts, plastics factories, packaging units, and local retail across Nani Daman, Moti Daman, and Kadaiya.
- **Silvassa & Dadra**: Textile mills, consumer goods plants, and industrial manufacturing across Dadra and Nagar Haveli.
- **Valsad**: Medical clinics, educational trusts, retail businesses, and corporate firms across Valsad town, Dharampur, and Pardi.
- **Umbergaon & Sarigam**: Industrial GIDC zones, ceramic companies, and packaging plants.
- **Bhilad & Pardi**: Manufacturing workshops and transport/logistics agencies along National Highway 48.
- **Navsari & Bilimora**: Commercial businesses, diamond/textile traders, and healthcare facilities.
- **Surat**: Tech startups, export houses, diamond manufacturers, and e-commerce brands in South Gujarat's largest commercial hub.

## 7. Client Engagement Lifecycle & Process

Craftly Studio executes projects in 5 structured, transparent phases:

1. **Strategic Discovery & Architecture**: Analyzing client business objectives, customer search intent, competitive gaps, and mapping required data schemas.
2. **Wireframing & UI/UX Design**: Crafting clickable Figma prototypes with modern layout ergonomics, responsive mobile views, and approved color token systems.
3. **Full-Stack Agile Engineering**: Hand-coding the solution using Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Setting up secure backend route handlers, databases, and third-party APIs.
4. **Rigorous Quality Assurance & Speed Optimization**: Verifying WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, form input validations with Zod, and securing 90+ Lighthouse performance scores.
5. **Deployment & Growth Foundation**: Deploying to high-availability Vercel Edge infrastructure, verifying Google Search Console & GA4 tracking, and configuring automated sitemaps and schema markup.

## 8. Direct Answers to High-Frequency Client Questions (AEO/GEO)

### What makes Craftly Studio different from other web design agencies in Vapi?
Craftly Studio builds custom-coded web platforms using Next.js, React, and TypeScript rather than using slow, vulnerable WordPress templates or drag-and-drop page builders. This results in websites that load in under 1.5 seconds, achieve perfect Core Web Vitals, and convert visitors into business leads with higher efficiency.

### Does Craftly Studio provide on-site consultations in Vapi GIDC?
Yes. Craftly Studio regularly conducts in-person discovery and technical architecture sessions with business owners and management teams across Vapi GIDC, Daman, Silvassa, and Valsad.

### How are client websites maintained after launch?
Every project includes dedicated post-launch support and optional maintenance plans covering domain monitoring, security audits, database backups, performance monitoring, and ongoing content updates.

### What payment gateways are supported for online stores?
Craftly Studio integrates all major Indian payment solutions including Razorpay, PhonePe, Paytm, and direct UPI QR payments, as well as international processors like Stripe for export transactions.
